```yaml
name: Update Ingestr Version

on:
  schedule:
    # Check for new releases every day at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    # Allow manual triggering

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  check-and-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get latest ingestr release
        id: get_latest_release
        run: |
          LATEST_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
          # Remove 'v' prefix if present
          LATEST_VERSION=${LATEST_VERSION#v}
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get current ingestr version
        id: get_current_version
        run: |
          # Assuming the version is defined in a specific file, e.g., version.go or a constant
          # Adjust the grep/sed command based on where ingestrVersion is defined in your codebase
          # Example: if it's in internal/version/version.go or similar
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -oP 'ingestrVersion\s*=\s*"\K[^"]+' $(find . -name "*.go" -exec grep -l "ingestrVersion" {} \; | head -n 1) || echo "0.0.0")
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compare versions
        id: compare
        run: |
          CURRENT="${{ steps.get_current_version.outputs.current_version }}"
          LATEST="${{ steps.get_latest_release.outputs.latest_version }}"
          
          if [ "$CURRENT" != "$LATEST" ]; then
            echo "new_version_found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "new_version=$LATEST" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "new_version_found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update version and create PR
        if: steps.compare.outputs.new_version_found == 'true'
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION="${{ steps.compare.outputs.new_version }}"
          
          # Find the file containing ingestrVersion
          VERSION_FILE=$(find . -name "*.go" -exec grep -l "ingestrVersion" {} \; | head -n 1)
          
          if [ -z "$VERSION_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Error: Could not find file containing ingestrVersion"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Update the version in the file
          # This sed command assumes the format: ingestrVersion = "x.y.z"
          sed -i "s/ingestrVersion\s*=\s*\"[^\"]*\"/ingestrVersion = \"$NEW_VERSION\"/" "$VERSION_FILE"
          
          # Configure git
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          
          # Create a new branch
          BRANCH_NAME="update-ingestr-to-${NEW_VERSION}"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Commit changes
          git add "$VERSION_FILE"
          git commit -m "chore: bump ingestr version to $NEW_VERSION"
          
          # Push to remote
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Create Pull Request
          gh pr create \
            --title "chore: bump ingestr version to $NEW_VERSION" \
            --body "Automated PR to update ingestr version from \`${{ steps.get_current_version.outputs.current_version }}\` to \`$NEW_VERSION\`." \
            --base main \
            --head "$BRANCH_NAME"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
